claim: On April 30, 2024 the Quick documentation history added Amazon Q in Quick, which gave QuickSight users generative BI capabilities through new Admin Pro, Author Pro and Reader Pro roles.
question: Since when does QuickSight offer generative BI through Amazon Q?

qualifiers.scope: Amazon Q in Quick (Amazon Q in QuickSight) generative BI capabilities
qualifiers.condition: The row uses the names Amazon Q in Quick and Amazon QuickSight; QuickSight became Amazon Quick Suite on 2025-10-09, see quick-change-2025-10-quicksight-rebrand.
